question: How does a real Playwright BrowserContext select and delete same-named cookies across two unrelated domains, and does cookies(url) isolate the candidate release set?
interpretation: Real Playwright/Chromium cookie behavior supplies the missing browser-side premise for the source finding: unfiltered BrowserContext.cookies() exposes both domains to releaseInstantCookie, while URL-filtered retrieval narrows deletion to cookies applicable to the selected application URL.
limits: This control executes Playwright and Chromium directly but does not execute the Next.js e2e harness, CookieStore lock events, or rendering. The exact-current Next.js target test remains a separate execution gate.
